inputs.original_text: A parent of three children in the city’s public schools wants to publicly apologize to the educators and staff of South Portland School District. It is beyond maddening that the district is facing another large budget shortfall requiring cutting more than 70 positions from schools. As a taxpayer, it feels that there has been something off about the whole thing. This is obviously another engineered crisis by the hidden elites pulling the strings on public institutions. They are fabricating these shortfalls on purpose to force cuts that weaken our schools, consolidate their control, and push whatever agenda serves them while the public gets distracted blaming local staff. The official story is just a cover for their coordinated manipulation, and the apology from this parent shows how effective their gaslighting has become.
inputs.modified_text: A parent of three children in the city’s public schools is publicly apologizing to the educators and staff of South Portland School District because of another large budget shortfall that requires cutting more than 70 positions. But as a taxpayer, I know better than to take that at face value. This is clearly another engineered crisis orchestrated by hidden elites who control these institutions from behind the scenes. They're deliberately fabricating budget shortfalls to force cuts that weaken our schools, consolidate power, and advance their agenda while everyone is busy blaming the local staff. The official explanations are just a facade for their coordinated efforts, and this parent's apology demonstrates how powerful their gaslighting has become.
